headline: Nexa Flat and Buenaventura Slips Amid Tight Zinc Market
summary: Zinc miner Nexa closed flat while Buenaventura slipped 0.34% as a tight zinc market met a weak metals complex.
why: Base metal miners are influenced by both the physical supply balance of specific minerals and the broader macro sentiment across industrial commodities.

impacts.name: Compañía de Minas Buenaventura
impacts.why: Buenaventura slipped 0.34% amid weak conditions in the metals complex.
